'''Darth Hoth Trooper uprising''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 9 April 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Local Uprising / Liberation|SE-L-localuprising.gif|label=Local Uprising}}
* '''Strategy:''' Local Uprising
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 LU Hoth LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

those large uprising sometimes become more than just annoying.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

First action: (activation:8)Use Strike Planning to pull Dodonna and Rieekan. After activating, use Insurrection combo to pull DB, and look for Launcing the Assault. If it's there, take it into hand using Wokling, and deploy to Hoth. Use it to grab Home One. Use Echo Base Garrison to search for Bacta Tank. Deploy the 2 Generals, and use Rieekan's text to take a card into hand. Use the objective to get a site.
2nd turn: (activation:9) use Dodonna's text to grab Gospic, then use him to get Willard. Use Rieekan to get another card, and EBG to get Luke. Use the objective to get the other site.
3rd turn: (activation:10) Use Willard to get Leia, who gets Reflection and Leia of Alderaan. Use objective to get Echo Base Troopers.
Subsequent turns: continue to get out the troopers and use Luke to get the T-47's. Deploy the Mon Cals to Hoth, and force drain away. Use Romas "Lock" Navander to lower the sheild if needed. Retrieve using Reflection, and, late in the game, Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes. During battles at Hoth, use the Ion Cannon to take out the starships.

Shewski: thanks for the review. I didn't include T-47 formation due to a lack of room. I will drop some suppresive fires and try without the Leia strain and add some SWM and the T-47 formation.
